high_level_description: This image is a collage of six photographs capturing various scenes during sunset or sunrise, showcasing different settings and moods. Top Left: This photo features a serene riverside scene at dusk. The sky is painted with hues of pink and purple, transitioning into darker shades as it meets the horizon. A tree with dense green foliage stands prominently on the right side, partially obscuring the view of the river. In the background, there are buildings with illuminated windows, suggesting an urban area. The calm water reflects the colors of the sky, adding to the tranquil atmosphere.
